recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片幾乎整片被一致的小型深染淋巴球取代，呈瀰漫性（diffuse）浸潤、正常造血與脂肪幾乎消失，只在邊緣殘留骨小樑，符合慢性淋巴球性白血病（CLL）骨髓廣泛侵犯，可解釋血小板低下。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow core with near-total effacement of fat and hematopoiesis
Diffuse, sheet-like infiltrate of monotonous small round lymphoid cells with dense nuclei
No well-formed paratrabecular nodules; pattern is diffuse rather than nodular or interstitial
Residual bony trabeculae and a small area of hemorrhagic/residual marrow at the edges
Pale areas suggestive of proliferation centers are not clearly resolved at this magnification
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power is markedly hypercellular, with near-complete replacement of marrow fat and normal trilineage hematopoiesis by a diffuse infiltrate of small, monotonous lymphoid cells. Bony trabeculae are present at the periphery, with only a narrow rim of residual marrow elements. Cytologic detail and proliferation centers cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with extensive diffuse marrow involvement by chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma, a pattern that correlates with marrow failure and cytopenias.

ddx.vs: Can look identical at low power; cyclin D1/SOX11 positivity and CD23 negativity distinguish it from CLL.
Tends to show nodular/intrasinusoidal infiltrates with monocytoid cells and is CD5-negative, CD23-negative by immunophenotype.
Shows admixed plasmacytoid cells, plasma cells and mast cells with IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P.
Packed marrow is composed of larger blasts with fine chromatin and mitoses rather than small mature lymphocytes; TdT is positive.
